source.title: I care – Pflege
source.basis: Uploaded textbook only; no external clinical facts merged.

notes: P7 source signals were re-routed by PDF section position where possible.
Mass cards were deterministically reconstructed from source evidence and subjected to global mechanical/content-shape QA.
Items failing P7B gates are excluded from production rather than silently shipped.
Current-guidance modernization is not part of this source-faithful bank.
P9 reconstructs textbook section titles from PDF heading typography to repair multi-line truncation.
False figure-caption sections 28.9 and 59.16 were removed and their concepts re-routed.
Seven omitted real parent sections were reconstructed.
The synthetic 36.3–36.4 pilot section was removed; its concepts now live in the real 36.3/36.4 hierarchy.
P10 branding finalized as PflegeLern for repository /pflegelern and GitHub Pages release.
P13 expands the source-faithful application bank to 120 cases using conservative synthesized scenarios backed by certified 2015 textbook concepts.

P14 calibrates flashcard self-assessment without changing the three visible ratings or FSRS mapping. Structured source-backed answers can show a compact Kernpunkte checklist, and every revealed card receives concise rating criteria.

P15 selectively offers optional free recall on direct-retrieval flashcards. Typed recall is shown back to the learner after reveal for self-comparison, is never auto-graded, never changes FSRS directly, and is cleared after rating.

P16 adds optional exam-horizon planning using only an exam date and scope. The planner changes selection priority and exam scope without changing FSRS due dates, forcing extra daily workload, or introducing new clinical facts.

P17 replaces the formerly small fixed question component of recommended study with a bounded adaptive mix driven by due backlog, weakness, exposure, objective-coverage debt, application debt, question/concept recency and P16 exam proximity. Due reviews remain protected and no FSRS state is rewritten by the mix layer.

P18 introduces Mastery Model v2. It separates cued recall, productive recall, objective practice, exam evidence, application evidence and spaced stability; uses distinct study days to resist same-session inflation; reads legacy v1.0/v1.1 evidence conservatively; and keeps the learner-facing result simple as Neu, Noch üben or Sicher.

P19 converts mistakes into bounded concept-level repair sequences. Immediate repair uses support cards plus distinct transfer/application questions when available, exact failed items are not used as independent evidence, unresolved weaknesses receive spaced follow-up without modifying FSRS due dates, and repeated same-day remediation is capped.

P20 upgrades the existing Prüfung flow into Mock Exam System v2 with configurable 5–100 question exams, optional 5–180 minute timers, whole-bank/weakness/multi-chapter scope, balanced objective question-type blueprints, unanswered and flagged overview, deterministic end-only grading, detailed type/topic breakdown, and direct handoff to P19 targeted remediation. P20 reuses the existing examAttempts store, preserves P16 scope planning, feeds results through the P18/P19 exam evidence chain, and never fabricates FSRS reviews or new clinical facts.
